metadata.content_note: This file is the GRAMMAR (task templates), not quest content. Generated postings carry no invented NPC names: requester is left blank on generated jobs until content production names requesters. Rescue jobs take their requester species from the caller's species pool (a Pokemon asking for help, PMD-style, with its SpriteCollab portrait id).
metadata.numbers_note: Every number in this file is a PUW DESIGN CONSTANT unless a field says otherwise. stamps_per_card = 7 is adopted from Pokemon GO's field-research stamp cadence (7 stamps to a breakthrough), per the memo. Rank names are Pokemon Mystery Dungeon rescue-team ranks (Normal / Bronze / Silver / Gold / Diamond / Lucario); the point thresholds are design constants.
metadata.source: design_decisions/MEMO_1_QUEST_SPINE.md (Bossy ruling, 2026-11-23): the PMD job board is the spine (per-place boards, per-region rank, Lumeris is the system's canon home); GO research contributes the task taxonomy, the stamp -> breakthrough cadence, and the special-chain shape. GO's placelessness and real-clock timing are rejected: all windows are in-world (world day / time of day / weather / festival) read from PUWWorldClock values passed in by the caller.
metadata.title: PUW quest grammar - PMD job board spine with GO research task grammar
